Cross
Century Classic - Chrome Silver-Tone
Vintage, 2 Piece Set with Presentation Box
This classic Cross Century writing set includes a matched ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, exemplifying the sleek, minimalist design that defined professional stationary in the late 20th century. Established in 1846, the A.T. Cross Company is renowned for its iconic conical top and pinstripe barrel textures. This set features the high-polish chrome finish with a vertical engine-turned line pattern, offering a timeless aesthetic and balanced writing weight.
Verified "CROSS USA" stamp on the cap of each piece
Classic Century pinstripe design with iconic black conical tops
Set includes: 1 twist-action ballpoint pen and 1 twist-action mechanical pencil
Original green and gold presentation box included
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Writing instruments show light surface scratches and minor handling wear consistent with age and use. No deep gouges, dents, or personalized engravings. Twist mechanisms for both the pen and pencil are intact with no visible damage. The presentation box shows light external storage wear but remains structurally sound.
